<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$agent-self-improve</code></p>

Review Codex conversations for communication failures and durable guidance gaps, then propose small approval-gated fixes. Use only when explicitly invoked with $agent-self-improve for a communication or agent-guidance review.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link agent-self-improve --scope user
arcantry skills link agent-self-improve --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link agent-self-improve --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Examples

### Review a frustrating project task

**Prompt**

> Use $agent-self-improve to review this project's recent tasks. Focus on why the agent kept asking questions the repository already answered.

**Expected outcome**

A diagnosis tied to conversation evidence and numbered, approval-gated edits for the narrowest guidance layer.

### Evaluate a supplied transcript

**Prompt**

> Use $agent-self-improve on this transcript and explain whether the failure came from execution, a skill, or project instructions.

**Expected outcome**

A scoped cause analysis that does not blame prompt wording or edit agent configuration without approval.
